title: Each state's newest official salary for its governor, legislators and judges
usableAnswer: A table by place and office giving the annual salary, the date it took effect, and the official source read, so that each row can replace the Book of the States 2023 figure the game holds. California is already replaced ($128,215 since December 4, 2023).
